data.title: Agility Robotics (AGLT) Stock Keeps Valuation Questions Open Despite Nasdaq Debut
data.description: Agility Robotics has just arrived on Nasdaq after its reverse merger, and the stock has already moved enough to make investors ask a simple question: Is the current price putting a fair tag on the company compared with the book value that sits on its balance sheet? The share price has climbed about 21.5% over the past week, which puts fresh focus on whether recent buying now stretches or still aligns with what the underlying net assets support.
